entries.title: Staggered pairs in empty ground
entries.description: No heading. Photographs are placed one or two per screen so that more than half of every screen stays empty ground. Screen one: a 3:4 portrait in columns 1–4 against the left margin, and a near-square 5:4 image in columns 7–12 against the right margin whose top edge starts 30vh lower than the portrait's. Screen two: a 3:2 landscape in columns 6–11 and, 24vh lower, a small 4:5 image in columns 2–4. Repeat the two arrangements, mirrored on the second pass, for six to ten photographs. Under each image's left corner, a one-line caption at 13px in the soft ink, 10px below the image. Vertical gaps between pairs are 22–28vh. Every edge sits on a column line and offsets come from only two values. Square corners. If motion is used, images enter with a short `clip-path` wipe from the bottom edge.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Photo tiles with label strips
entries.description: Four columns with 12px gaps; every tile is a photograph with a filled label strip attached directly beneath it, the two forming one object like a print with its swing tag. The photograph is 1:1 or 4:5 with square corners. The strip is the same width, 84–96px tall with 12px padding, and holds two or three rows of text at 12–13px in the text face with tabular figures: row one spreads four short values evenly across the width with `justify-content: space-between`; row two puts a date at the left end and a time or place at the right end; row three names the maker or model. Strip and text colours change per tile through four palette pairs (dark on bright, bright on dark), so a uniform grid looks varied. Rows of tiles are 28px apart. A two- or three-word heading at 32px sits top-left, 40px above the grid. Holds 8–16 tiles.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Wall of word tiles
entries.description: A gallery that works with no photographs: a four-column grid of identical square cells with 8px gaps running three or more rows, edge to edge with 8px margins. Each cell is a flat filled tile and centres one large element about 55% of the cell's width: a single word, a letter, a figure with its unit, or a simple inline SVG shape taken from the subject, set at clamp(56px, 9vw, 150px) in the display face. A one- or two-word caption at 14px sits centred 18px above the cell's bottom edge. Tile and ink colours rotate through three or four palette pairs in a fixed order, so a uniform grid looks varied. Where photographs exist, every third or fourth cell is a photograph covering its tile, all given one treatment. There is no hierarchy between cells: it is a specimen sheet. A heading is optional; if used, it occupies the first cell as that cell's word.

entries.title: Accordion of tinted panels
entries.description: A two-column introduction, then one horizontal accordion. Introduction: the heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px), in columns 1–5; one paragraph at 18px in columns 7–11. 64px below, a flex row across columns 1–12, 520px tall, of four to six panels with no gaps. The open stage is a panel taking about 58% of the width; the rest are vertical slivers sharing what remains. Order is carried by colour: the first stage is the darkest tone of one hue and each later stage is a lighter flat tint of it, so the row reads dark to light from left to right. A sliver shows only its stage name, rotated 90 degrees and reading upward, at 20px bold, anchored to its bottom-left. The open panel shows the name at 40px top-left, a 36ch paragraph at 18px bottom-left and, optionally, one photograph in its right half. Clicking a sliver opens it (flex-basis transition, 450ms).

entries.title: Call and response column
entries.description: The sequence is shown as what you give and what comes back, in one narrow column 560px wide starting at column 4, or on the page's text axis. Three exchanges, 88px apart. Each opens with a sentence at 20px medium that begins with its order word ('First, install it.' 'Then ask for a chart.'). 16px under it, the call: the literal thing the user enters, in a filled panel one tone off the ground, radius 8px, padding 20px. For a developer tool that is real code in `<pre><code>` at 14px with a working copy button; otherwise it is the product's own input holding real typed text. Under the call, indented 56px, the response: a true-size fragment marked data-ui showing what the product returns. The third response is the finished result and breaks out of the column, 760px wide, running to column 12. The heading, two to four words at 28px, sits 56px above the first sentence.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Drag row of moments
entries.description: A story told left to right. Top row: the heading, two to four words at 28–36px, at the left margin; at the right margin two solid square buttons, 48px each, for back and forward. Directly beneath, a solid bar 6px tall spans the full width in a soft tone, with a full-ink segment showing how far the row has been scrolled. Then the row itself: six to nine columns, each 280px wide with 32px gaps, in a horizontally scrolling flex container with scroll-snap that bleeds off both viewport edges. Every column reads top to bottom: a one-line caption at 18px bold that carries the order in words ('We met', 'Two winters on', 'The move'), three lines at 15px in the soft ink, then 80–140px of empty space that varies per column, then a 4:5 portrait photograph. Because the spaces vary, the photographs' top edges rise and fall along the row.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Drag through the stages
entries.description: A 50/50 split, 88svh tall: two flat fields meeting on a clean vertical edge, and one slider that drives both. Left field: the current stage as a clause of three to six words at clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 76px) on two lines, top-left from column 1, starting with its order word; it serves as the heading. Right field: one fragment of the product at true size, about 440px wide, centred, root marked data-ui, in the state that matches the clause. Along the bottom, crossing both fields inside 28px margins, a real range `<input>` with four stops: a solid track 8px tall, the part already passed in full ink, and a square thumb 32px across in the accent. Under the track, four stage names at 16px, the current one in full ink. Dragging, or the arrow keys, swaps the clause and the fragment's state with a 200ms crossfade; nothing depends on scroll.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Itinerary on a slip
entries.description: The process is printed as an itinerary or receipt. One paper-coloured slip 420–480px wide stands on a contrasting flat ground at columns 7–11; its bottom edge is a zigzag cut with clip-path and its top edge is straight. The heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 68px), sits in columns 1–5 with a 30ch paragraph, top-aligned with the slip. On the slip, in the text face at 16px with tabular figures: stages grouped under time headings that carry the order ('Monday', 'Midweek', 'Friday'), each heading in bold with 28px above it. Under a heading, two to four rows; each row has what happens on the left, a duration or time on the right, and a leader of round 4px dots between. The final row is inverted, paper-coloured text on a full-width ink bar 44px tall, and states the result: what the reader holds at the end and the total time.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Lines that step across
entries.description: The sequence is written, not counted. Four lines of display type, one stage per line, each a complete short clause that begins with its order word: 'First you send it.' 'Then we take it apart.' 'You choose one.' 'It ships on Friday.' Set at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 76px), leading 1.0, one line each. The first line starts on column 1 and each following line starts two columns further right (grid-column-start 1, 3, 5, 7), so the block descends as a staircase and the eye follows the diagonal. Under each line, on that line's own left edge and 12px below, a sentence of up to 34ch at 17px in the soft ink. 56px between stages. The last line may take the accent colour as the single emphasis. The first line serves as the heading; there is no title above. Leave the columns to the left of the final stage empty.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Many into one
entries.description: A diagram drawn with one repeated shape instead of arrows. The heading (two to four words on two lines at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px)) and a short paragraph at 17px sit in columns 1–4. Beneath, a wide inline SVG spans columns 1–12 at about 4.5:1. It is built from 120–160 small filled squares (or the page's own motif), each 10–14px. In the left third they are scattered loosely in two pale tones. In the middle third they are pulled into a tight horizontal ribbon three squares high. In the right third they fan out again into neat, evenly spaced rows in the accent colour. The eye reads disorder, compression, order, from left to right. Under the diagram, three text columns aligned to its thirds: a bold one-word name at 20px and two lines at 16px each; the words carry the sequence ('Gather', 'Reduce', 'Release'). No connecting marks.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One card, four fields
entries.description: Four flat colour fields stand side by side across the full viewport, each 25vw wide and 84svh tall, butted together with no gaps; neighbours differ clearly in lightness. The same card from the product (a ticket, an order, a request) appears once in each field at the same height, 38% down, centred, 260px wide at true size, each copy marked data-ui. It is further along every time: bare as it arrives, then with an owner and a due date, then with its checklist half ticked, then closed with its final figure. Along the bottom of each field, 28px in, one clause at clamp(22px, 2vw, 32px) on two lines begins with its order word: 'First it lands here.' 'Then someone takes it.' The heading, two to four words at the same size in the heaviest weight, sits top-left in the first field only. On hover a field's card rises 6px over 150ms.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One verb at a time
entries.description: Three to five full-bleed panels, each 100svh tall, stacked with no gap; each is one stage and holds one photograph covering it. In every panel a single word, the verb for that stage ('Cut', 'Fold', 'Stitch', 'Press'), is set at clamp(96px, 17vw, 300px), heavy and centred, inside a wrapper that is position: sticky; top: 50% and shifted up by half its own height. Because each word is sticky only within its own panel, it holds the centre of the screen while its photograph passes behind it, and is then pushed out by the next panel's verb. Use mix-blend-mode: difference in white, or one solid colour tested on every image. One sentence at 18px sits in the bottom-left corner of each panel over a neutral scrim limited to that corner. There is no separate heading: the verbs, read in order, are both the heading and the sequence.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Photographs down a diagonal
entries.description: Three stages, three photographs of different sizes placed along a falling diagonal on the 12-column grid. Stage one: a 3:4 portrait in columns 1–4. Stage two: a 1:1 square in columns 6–8, its top edge 220px lower than the first photograph's top. Stage three: a 16:10 landscape in columns 8–12, starting 180px below the bottom of the second. Each stage's text sits in the gap the stagger leaves: a paragraph of up to 36ch at 17px, top-aligned with its photograph and placed in the columns to its right (to its left for the third). Each paragraph opens with a bold run-in phrase that carries the order: 'On the first day', 'A week later', 'By the end'. Square corners; no arrows or connecting marks. The heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 64px) in a light weight, sits alone in columns 7–12 at the very top, level with the first photograph's top edge.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Pinned fragment, changing state
entries.description: Two columns. Right, columns 7–12: a stage that is position: sticky; top: 14vh, holding one fragment of the real interface at true size on a single flat stage colour, about 520px square. Left, columns 1–5: three statements, each in its own block 80vh tall, so one is in view at a time. A statement is a two-line sentence at 28–32px that begins with its order word ('Paste a link.', 'Then pick the parts you want.', 'Share it when it looks right.') plus one supporting line at 16px. The statement nearest the viewport's centre is in full ink; the others sit at 30%. As each statement becomes active the fragment changes to the matching state: an empty field, a filled list with two rows selected, a finished result with its confirmation. Build the states in HTML and switch a class; do not swap screenshots. The heading, two to four words at 24–28px, sits above the first statement.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Run-in column
entries.description: The quietest sequence: one reading column and good typography. A single column 520–600px wide starts at about 30% of the viewport width (or sits on the page's text axis). The heading is a two-to-five-word question or statement at 28–32px, 48px above the first paragraph. Three to five paragraphs follow at 17–18px with line-height 1.6. Each opens with a bold run-in phrase in full ink that names its moment ('To begin,', 'Within a day,', 'After that,', 'From then on,') while the rest of the paragraph runs in the soft ink; there are no subheads, bullets or markers. After each paragraph, 20px lower, comes one small piece of evidence exactly as wide as the column: a cropped interface fragment, a photograph at 16:9, or a row of three small frames 96px tall. 72px separates stages. Nothing in the section is wider than the column, and the space to its left stays empty.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Stages as one bar
entries.description: The product's progress bar, enlarged until it spans the page, is the diagram. One bar runs across columns 1–12, 22vh tall, built as a flex row of three or four solid segments with 6px gaps, root marked data-ui. Each segment's width follows how long that stage really takes (flex-grow from the true durations, 12% minimum), and each is a different flat palette colour, so the reader sees at once that signing up is a sliver and the rest is the product working. Inside every segment, top-left with 20px padding, its duration in words at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px): 'Two minutes', 'About a day'. Under each segment, on its left edge, one clause at 17px, 22ch wide, beginning with its order word. Above the bar, 64px clear of it, the heading: two to five words at clamp(48px, 6.4vw, 104px), flush left. Nothing else.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Tiles that grow
entries.description: Order is carried by size. Three flat colour tiles stand in one row, bottom-aligned (align-items: end) with 10px gaps, each larger than the one before: columns 1–3 at 30vh tall, columns 4–7 at 44vh, columns 8–12 at 60vh. Each tile holds one photograph of the subject at that stage (raw, in progress, finished), centred and scaled so the object grows from tile to tile; on light tiles mix-blend-mode: multiply removes a white studio background. One palette colour per tile. Text sits under the tiles, outside them, aligned to each tile's left edge: a stage name at 20px medium whose wording carries the order ('Picked', 'Pressed', 'Poured') and two lines at 16px in the soft ink. The heading, two to four words at 40–52px, occupies the empty ground above the two smaller tiles, top-aligned with the tallest tile. A fourth stage is possible with spans of 2, 3, 3 and 4 columns.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Edge-to-edge heavy paragraph
entries.description: A full-bleed flat colour field, at least 90svh tall, filled by one paragraph and nothing else. The paragraph is 35–55 words in the heaviest weight at clamp(36px, 5vw, 76px), leading 0.98, left-aligned, running from a 16px left margin to a 16px right margin so its lines reach both edges; use `text-wrap: pretty` and no hyphenation. No heading: the paragraph is the section. In two or three places a word-sized gap (an inline-block spacer 2.5em wide) opens inside a line. One small photograph, 9vw wide at 4:5 with square corners, is absolutely placed over the first two lines, rotated 4 degrees, covering parts of two words; a second chip at 6vw may sit in one of the gaps. Text takes the field's assigned ink at full contrast. The field butts against the section above with no space between them. On a page without images, drop the chips and close the gaps.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Heading captions a panorama
entries.description: The section is exactly 100svh. Its top third holds a two-line heading of three to six words at clamp(48px, 6.5vw, 96px) with leading 0.95, either centred or flush left on the page margin. 28px beneath the heading sit two small captions side by side, each two lines at 13px and 150px wide with a 48px gap, aligned to the heading (centred as a pair, or both starting at its left edge). 40px below them a full-bleed photograph begins and runs off the bottom of the viewport: it is 100vw wide at 21:9 or wider, and only its top 55–60svh is visible before the fold, the rest arriving with scroll. The heading therefore reads as a large caption to the picture. On an object-led page the image is the object on a flat dark panel inset by the page margin instead of bleeding to the edges.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Headline crossing onto a photograph
entries.description: A white or pale ground. A photograph taller than it is wide, 720px wide (columns 7–12), sits flush against the right viewport edge with its top at 46% of the section's first screen and runs below the fold. The heading starts on the 32px left margin across columns 1–8: two lines of light-weight serif capitals at clamp(64px, 5.6vw, 88px), leading 1.04, the first line starting 34% down the screen and the second placed so that its right half runs onto the photograph's upper-left corner. Choose a picture whose upper-left quarter is pale enough for the ink, or set the second line twice, in the ink and in the paper colour, each copy clipped to its side of the photograph's left edge. Under the heading on columns 1–5, one paragraph of up to 25 words at 22px, leading 1.4. At the bottom-left a second, smaller photograph of 360×400px enters, cropped by the screen's lower edge, and on the next screen becomes the left half of a staggered pair with the large one. Nothing else is on the screen.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Statement with inline thumbnails
entries.description: A centred statement of 18–28 words, four lines at clamp(32px, 4.2vw, 62px), medium or bold weight, leading 1.12, in a block 60–66% of the viewport wide with 22vh of empty ground above and below. Three to five small frames sit inline between words: each is an `inline-block` 0.85em tall and 0.85–1.3em wide, `vertical-align: -0.1em`, radius 0.14em, holding a tightly cropped photograph (or a crop of real interface) of the thing the neighbouring word names. Frames are part of the line, never floating over it, with 0.12em of space either side. No heading above and no paragraph below; the statement is set as a `p`. Directly under the section the page may split into two flat colour halves or begin the first product row, so the thumbnails read as a preview of what follows. On a motif-driven page every frame takes the motif's shape.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Lead line over four columns
entries.description: Two parts on one 12-column grid with 20px margins. First, a lead paragraph of 30–40 words spans all 12 columns at clamp(22px, 2.2vw, 32px), regular weight, leading 1.2: three lines that read as the opening of a text, with no heading before it. 72px below, four equal columns (three grid columns each, 24px gutters) carry small text at 14–15px with leading 1.45. Each column is one paragraph of 40–70 words that opens with a bold run-in phrase of two or three words in full ink, the rest continuing on the same line in the soft ink. Columns top-align and end ragged at different depths. No cards, icons or dividers; the bold run-ins are the only markers. The four columns answer four plain questions: who, what, where, how to reach them. Padding is modest, 96px top and bottom, so a sheet of images can start straight after.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Narrow column, empty field
entries.description: A single text column 300–340px wide, its left edge at 15% of the viewport width, starting 64px below the section top. It holds four or five short paragraphs at 15–16px with leading 1.5 and one blank line between them; the first paragraph is in medium weight and full ink, the rest in regular weight and the soft ink. No heading, no image, no button; one underlined text link may end the last paragraph. The remaining three-quarters of the 1440 screen is untouched ground, and the section is only as tall as the text plus 160px of padding below. The column's left edge must match a line used elsewhere on the page (the wordmark's left edge or a later column). Where the page has a large object or a fixed photograph, this column is the small text beside it. Holds 90–150 words comfortably.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Pinned sentence, photographs pass
entries.description: A wrapper 300svh tall. Inside it a `position: sticky; top: 0` layer of 100svh holds one sentence of 8–14 words, centred, three lines at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 68px), leading 1.1, in a block 62% of the viewport wide. The sentence is a paragraph, not a heading; it is white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` (or a solid ink that reads over every photograph) and has a higher `z-index` than the images. Behind it, three photographs sit in normal flow at different sizes and sides and scroll past the fixed sentence: a 4:5 portrait 24vw wide with its left edge at 6vw; 70svh lower a 16:10 landscape 38vw wide touching the right margin; 70svh lower a 1:1 frame 18vw wide starting at 30vw. Each crosses the sentence once. When the wrapper ends, the sentence releases and scrolls away with the last photograph. No scroll hijacking.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
entries.description: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Staircase statement
entries.description: On a flat dark or saturated field one sentence of 12–18 words is broken into five short lines at clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 64px), bold, leading 1.02, marked up as one paragraph (a statement, so it may run past two lines at this size). Each line starts further right than the one above: indents of 0, 6, 12, 18 and 24vw from a 4vw left margin, set with `padding-left` per line, so the block descends like stairs and ends near the 75% mark. Each line takes its own flat colour from the palette, or lines alternate between two inks. The block is vertically centred in a section 100svh tall. The right quarter (columns 10–12) holds two stacked photographs, each 3:2 and 20vw wide with a 16px gap, top-aligned with the first line. No heading; a two-line note at 15px sits at the bottom-left margin, on the first line's left edge. On a page without images, leave the right quarter empty.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Statement tiles
entries.description: A board of filled tiles with 8px gaps and 8px outer margins: 12 columns by two rows of 38svh each. Tile A, columns 1–8 across both rows, is the darkest tile and carries a slogan of two to four words in capitals at clamp(64px, 9vw, 132px), leading 0.86, on two lines, set hard against the tile's 20px left padding and bottom-aligned. Tile B, columns 9–12 of row one, is a pale tile with one word or figure at the same size, bottom-aligned, cropped by `overflow: hidden` if it runs long. Tile C, columns 9–12 of row two, is a photograph covering the tile. Below the board a fourth tile spans all 12 columns in the page ground colour: its left half is empty and a text of 90–130 words at 22–24px with leading 1.35 runs in columns 7–12 with 40px padding. No separate heading: the slogan in tile A is the heading.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Title, note, facts row
entries.description: First row: a heading of two to four words in a light weight at clamp(44px, 5vw, 76px) sits on the left margin in columns 1–6; a three-line paragraph at 16px, 260px wide, sits in columns 10–12 with its last line on the heading's baseline. Columns 7–9 stay empty. 120px lower, a second row sets three or four facts (a date, a time, a place, a price) as large light text at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px), spread across the 12 columns with `justify-content: space-between`. Each fact has a one-line explanation at 14px directly under it in the soft ink, left-aligned to the fact. Facts are separated only by the space between them, so the row reads like the line of times on a printed programme. A solid caret block 0.08em wide blinks after the last character. 48px beneath, on the same left edge, the product's answer appears at true interface size, at most 560px wide: three result rows, one parsed value, or a swatch, updating as the visitor types. Bottom-left, three more examples at 17px act as plain text buttons that refill the line. The rest of the 88svh field is empty. If the text outgrows the line it scrolls inside the input; it never wraps.

entries.title: Input half, output half
entries.description: Two flat fields meet on a vertical edge at 50vw, each 90svh tall, no gap. The left field is the darkest palette tone and holds what the user hands the product, raw: a pasted note, a messy row of figures, a prompt, or literal code inside `<code>`. It is an editable region at 20–24px, 34ch wide, starting at column 2, 30% down the field. The right field is the lightest tone and holds what the product makes of it as a true-size fragment marked data-ui: the tidy record, the chart, the formatted reply, 440–520px wide, on the same top line. Editing the left changes the right. The heading is split across the edge: its first one or two words bottom-left on the dark field, its last one or two bottom-right on the light field, both at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) on one baseline 32px from the bottom.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Lit panel, dark row
entries.description: One dark field, 96svh tall. Across its middle runs a horizontal row of five to seven interface panels, each a different true-size fragment marked data-ui (an open menu, an inspector, a composer, a chart card), 320–460px wide at their natural heights, vertically centred and 26vw apart. The row scrolls sideways with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory and scroll-snap-align: center, and can be dragged. Only the panel at the centre is lit: full opacity, in the product's light theme, the brightest thing on screen. The others sit at 22% opacity and are inert. The viewport's edges crop the outermost panels. In the gap to the right of the centred panel, top-aligned with it, a 24ch column gives its name at 24px in a light weight and two lines at 16px in a lifted ink; this text changes as panels arrive. There is no heading above the row.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Live demo with controls
entries.description: One filled panel, 680–760px wide and about 640px tall, radius 12px, in a tone clearly darker or lighter than the ground, placed on the text column's left edge or centred, with at least 15vh of empty ground above and below. The panel is split 62/38 into two flat areas that differ by one tone. Left area: the product doing its job on real content at true size. Right area: a narrow column of working controls, six to nine stacked rows 44px tall, each with a name at 14px on the left and a slider, toggle or value on the right; changing one changes the demonstration at once. A text link sits in the panel's bottom-left corner. The heading, two to four words at 24–32px, sits above the panel on its left edge with one sentence at 16px; under the panel, one line of start instruction.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Object in front of type
entries.description: Type and object share one space instead of sitting side by side. Three or four lines of display type, one or two words each, are stacked flush left at clamp(72px, 9vw, 150px) with leading 0.88, starting on the left margin and allowed to leave the right edge (white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden on the section). The lines step through tones of one ink: one at 45%, one at full strength, the rest at 18%. The object photograph, a cut-out or a studio shot blended with multiply, is absolutely positioned over the upper right of the stack at 40–46vw wide, rotated no more than 6 degrees and above the type in the stacking order, so it hides parts of three or four letters. Under the stack, in columns 8–12, a two-paragraph block at 20px gives the facts. The full-strength line is the heading; nothing sits above it.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Object on a disc
entries.description: One section about a viewport tall on a plain ground. A flat filled disc 64vh across, in one palette colour, sits with its centre at 58% of the width; swap the disc for the subject's own shape if it has one. A cut-out object photograph stands in front of it, centred on it, about 78% of the disc's height and breaking the disc's outline at the top. Bottom-left, starting on the margin and ending level with the disc's lower edge: a vertical list of four to six item names at clamp(28px, 2.9vw, 44px), leading 1.15. The selected name is in full ink and the rest at 25%; choosing a name swaps the object (300ms crossfade) and the disc's colour. The heading, two to four words at the same size as the names but in the soft ink, is the first line of that list. One fact about the selected item sits at the disc's right edge at 17px.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One control, blown up
entries.description: A flat saturated field, full-bleed and 92svh tall, holds one working control from the product: the toggle, slider, segmented switch or record button the whole product turns on. Build it at true proportions with every dimension in em, mark its root data-ui, then raise that root's font-size until the control stands about 46vh tall. Anchor it right of centre so the section's right and bottom edges crop about a fifth of it (overflow: hidden on the section). It keeps its real label and value, now at poster size, and it works: operating it swaps the field between two palette colours and changes one word of the heading. The heading, two to four words at clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 40px), sits top-left on the page margin with one sentence at 17px beneath it. The lower-left third of the field stays empty.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One frame, three distances
entries.description: A wrapper 300vh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one frame is centred: 30vw wide at 4:5, square corners, overflow hidden. Inside it the same photograph is shown at three distances as the reader scrolls: the whole subject, then scaled to 180% toward one detail, then to 320% on a second detail (transform: scale with a transform-origin per stage, 700ms ease, switched by IntersectionObserver on three invisible markers). The sentence is delivered in halves: its first two or three words sit above the frame at clamp(56px, 8vw, 130px), centred; the last words arrive below the frame at the second stage, overlapping the frame's bottom edge by 0.3em. At the third stage one caption of 28ch at 17px appears to the right of the frame, top-aligned. The two halves together are the heading and stay within two lines.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One image across tiles
entries.description: One photograph is cut across a board of tiles. A grid of six columns and four rows with 8px gaps spans the full width between 12px margins; every tile is square (aspect-ratio: 1). Each tile shows its own piece of the same image: set the photograph as every tile's background at background-size: 600% 400% and step background-position by column and row, so the picture reads whole through the gaps. Five of the twenty-four tiles are swapped for flat colour tiles from the palette, never two adjacent: one holds the heading (two to four words at 2.6vw, top-left, 16px padding), three hold one fact each at 18px, one holds the action. On hover a tile's piece scales to 108% inside its own clip. Choose a photograph with one clear subject, so the board is legible at a glance.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One row, three states
entries.description: The product's central row (a task, a transaction, a message, a deploy) is shown three times, one directly beneath the other, in three states: as it arrives, with the pointer on it and its actions revealed, and finished. Each copy is built at true size, 640px wide, with real names, amounts and times, its root marked data-ui; inside it the product's own control borders and radii apply. The copies sit in columns 4–9 with 56px between them and nothing framing them. In columns 1–3, right-aligned and level with each copy, one word at 22px in the soft ink names its state. Columns 10–12 stay empty. The middle copy is live: its checkbox or button works and turns it into the third state. The heading, two to four words at 28–32px, sits on column 4's left edge, 96px above the first copy, with no supporting line.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Output index, live sheet
entries.description: For products that make documents: invoices, reports, emails, statements. Columns 1–5 list the names of three to five outputs, one per line, at clamp(36px, 4vw, 64px), leading 1.1, each a `<button>`; the selected name is in full ink, the rest in the soft ink. There is no other heading. Columns 7–12 are a stage in a flat tone one step from the ground, 88svh tall, and on it lies the selected output as an object: a paper-white sheet 560px wide, built in HTML at true size, root marked data-ui, with a real sender, real line items, sums that add up and a date. The sheet starts 72px below the stage's top and runs past its bottom edge, which crops it. Selecting a name swaps the sheet with a 200ms crossfade; an email is narrower (440px), a receipt narrower still (300px), all left-aligned 64px into the stage.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Output slips along the edge
entries.description: For subjects whose result is a piece of text or paper: a receipt, a note, a ticket, a written line. A full-bleed photograph, 100vw by 96svh, sets the scene. In the upper centre, left-aligned in a column starting at 18% of the width, two short paragraphs in paper colour at 28–32px, the first opening with the heading's two to four words; a neutral scrim sits behind that column only. Along the bottom, six paper-coloured slips stand side by side across the full width with 12px gaps, each a filled rectangle of a different height (between 26 and 44svh), their lower ends cut off by the section's bottom edge. Two or three of the slips, not all, are tilted by 1–2 degrees. Each slip carries a sample of real output in the text face at 15px: a bold first line, a divider made of typed characters, then four to eight lines.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Portrait on its own ground
entries.description: One chapter per screen, three to six chapters. Each is a full-bleed field 100svh tall whose flat colour is taken from its own photograph: the darkest large tone in the picture (a deep brown for a wooden interior, a slate for a winter coast), so picture and page seem to be one surface. In the centre stands one portrait photograph at 3:4, 506×675px (75% of the height), top 112px, square corners, no frame. Type sits in the corners on 32px margins in the light ink: the chapter's title at clamp(28px, 2.4vw, 36px) top-left as its heading; one sentence at 17px, max 32ch, bottom-left; a text link to the chapter's page bottom-right. As each chapter arrives its field starts as a panel inset 20px from the viewport edges and grows to full-bleed, while the portrait scales from 0.92 to 1 (background colour over 600ms, scale over 800ms, both easing out), so the change reads as the room changing, not as a new slide. A chapter may hold a short muted loop or a single enlarged letterform in place of the portrait, on the same kind of field. The first chapter's title doubles as the section heading.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Rows as a board
entries.description: The product's main list is set like a station departure board. Eight to ten real rows (transactions, issues, deploys, bookings) run the full viewport width inside 12px side margins. Each row is a filled band 72px tall, one tone off a dark ground, separated from the next by a 4px gap and never by a line; the whole board is one fragment marked data-ui. Text inside is 26–30px: the name from column 1, two or three facts at columns 6, 8 and 10, and at column 12 a status word on a solid block of its status colour; figures use tabular numerals. The section's top and bottom edges cut the first and last rows in half, so the list seems to continue. The fourth row is open: 216px tall, in the accent colour, with its detail in two lines at 17px. Clicking another row opens that one instead. No heading: the open row's name is the largest type.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Square plate, spare text
entries.description: One flat field split 50/50, at least 88svh tall. Left half: a single square photograph filling the half's width minus 40px margins, vertically centred, square corners. A large simple shape may be laid over it to turn the photograph into the object it stands for: a ring 86% of its width with a 6px stroke and a small solid dot at the centre makes a record; a notch cut by clip-path makes a ticket stub. Right half, a flex column with space-between: at the top a row of three plain text tabs at 18px (editions, years, variants), the active one in full ink and the others at 40%; in the middle the title, two to four words at 32–40px bold, with a 34ch description 48px below; along the bottom two filled rectangular cells side by side, each half the column wide and 72px tall, acting as the two actions, one in ink and one a tone off the field.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Two giant words compared
entries.description: No photographs: the thing shown is a pair of words, characters or figures that make the point by comparison (before and after, input and output, ours and the usual). At the top of the section, on one row: the heading, two to four words at 28–36px, at the left margin, and a paragraph of up to 60 words at 17px starting at column 7. Then 12vh of space. Below, two specimens side by side, one starting on column 1 and one on column 7, each set at clamp(180px, 34vw, 520px) with leading 0.8, so each fills about half the viewport's width. The section has a fixed height and overflow: hidden, so its bottom edge cuts both specimens at roughly 60% of their height. One short caption at 16px sits above the top-left of each specimen, naming it. Both specimens share one ink; the difference is in the letterforms or values, not in colour.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Two objects, two fields
entries.description: Two panels side by side, each 50vw wide and 92svh tall, in two different flat tones from the palette, meeting on a clean vertical edge with no gap. Each panel is dominated by one cut-out object photograph scaled to 130–150% of the panel's width and positioned so the panel's top edge crops it: the reader sees the lower two-thirds of the object, very close. On light panels use mix-blend-mode: multiply to lose a white studio background. Along the bottom of each panel, 28px in from the edges, one row: the name at 20px medium and a price or fact at 17px on the left; on the right, two small rectangular actions, one filled with ink and one with paper. Nothing sits in the middle of a panel. The heading, two to four words at 32–40px, is set at the top-left of the first panel only, in the empty corner beside the object.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Bars standing on the edge
entries.description: The product's own chart, drawn in HTML, is the whole section. A full-bleed field 90svh tall. Along its bottom edge stand ten to fourteen solid bars, one per true value (months, releases, cohorts), in a CSS grid spanning the full viewport width with 8px gaps and no side margins; heights are the values scaled so the tallest is 58vh. No axes, no grid, no legend; the chart's root is marked data-ui. Every bar is one tone two steps from the field except the one the page is about, which takes the accent. Three bars print their value directly above themselves at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px), tabular. The headline figure sits top-left on the page margin at clamp(88px, 10vw, 168px), and its claim, two to five words at 28px, sits beneath it on the same margin. Hovering or focusing a bar shows its value and period above it.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Column aligned on the decimal
entries.description: A tall column of figures set like a ledger. Left, columns 1–5: the heading as a statement of up to five words on two lines at clamp(32px, 3.2vw, 52px), its first line in the soft ink and its second in full ink, placed at mid-height. Right, columns 7–12: four to six figures stacked, each at clamp(64px, 7vw, 112px), leading 1.0, in tabular lining numerals. They align on the decimal point: each row is a three-part grid in which the whole-number part is right-aligned in the first track, the point and decimals are left-aligned in the second, and a caption of one or two lines at 16px sits in the third, on the figure's baseline. Whole numbers simply leave the second track empty. Rows are separated by 20px of space only. Units are written in the captions, not attached to the figures, so the numerals form one clean vertical shape.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Figure on the photograph's edge
entries.description: One full-bleed photograph, 100vw by 88svh, and one figure set on it the way a film title sits on a frame. The figure, with its unit, is at clamp(120px, 17vw, 280px), leading 0.8, in paper colour, hugging the bottom-left corner with 24px margins, its baseline nearly on the photograph's lower edge. A neutral dark scrim covers only the bottom 35% of the image for legibility. On the same baseline at the right margin, right-aligned, a sentence of up to 26ch at 18px explains the figure. At the top-left, small at 20–24px, sits the heading of two to four words; the middle of the photograph stays clear. Two smaller supporting figures may follow below the photograph, on the ground: each at 40px with a one-line caption beside it, starting at columns 1 and 7, 40px under the image. Choose a figure that belongs to the picture: a height, a distance, a temperature, a year.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Figure set by a slider
entries.description: The number is the visitor's own. A flat field at least 88svh tall. Top-left, on the page margin: a question of two to five words at 36–44px that serves as the heading ('How many invoices a month?'). 28px under it, one control from the product at true size, 400px wide, root marked data-ui: a slider with its real label and current value, or a stepper, or a short numeric field, preset to a typical answer. Then a long gap. Bottom-left, on the same edge, the result at clamp(140px, 19vw, 320px), heavy, leading 0.8, tabular numerals, with its unit at 0.22em on the same baseline. It recalculates on every input event from a stated, honest formula. Bottom-right, on the figure's baseline, one sentence at 17px, 30ch wide, says how the figure is worked out. No other figure appears in the section.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Figures inside a sentence
entries.description: The numbers are written into prose and the prose is set at display size. One paragraph of two or three sentences, 22–34 words, containing three or four true figures, in the pattern 'Since 2014 we have rebuilt 340 roofs in 9 towns, and 312 of them have never leaked.' Set at clamp(32px, 4.4vw, 72px), leading 1.12, in columns 2–11, left-aligned and vertically centred in a section of 80–90svh with nothing else in it. Words are in the soft ink at regular weight; the figures alone are in full ink (or the accent) at the same size, in lining numerals, with non-breaking spaces binding each figure to its unit. No boxes, underlines or colour chips behind the figures. A visually hidden two-word heading names the section for structure; to the eye the paragraph stands alone. On a deep ground use a light weight and a soft light ink, with the figures in the brightest ink.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One figure owns the screen
entries.description: One number, one screen. A flat field at least 90svh tall. At the top-left, starting on the page's main axis, a one-line claim of two to five words at 36–44px: this is the heading. Then a long gap of 22–28vh. At the bottom-left on the same edge, a single figure at clamp(180px, 23vw, 380px), leading 0.8, tight tracking, with its unit (a percent sign, 'x', 'hrs') set as a superscript one third of the figure's size and aligned to the figure's cap height. Directly beneath, flush with the figure's left edge, a caption of three lines at 16–17px, 32ch wide, saying exactly what was measured and when. The right half of the field stays empty; resist filling it. The figure is static text in lining numerals and does not animate. A source line, if needed, sits at the bottom-right at 15px.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Photograph with figure tiles
entries.description: A mosaic without gutters spanning the full width, about 66vw tall in total. A single photograph fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1 with object-fit: cover and square corners. The right third is split into two stacked flat colour tiles of equal height, in two palette colours that differ clearly in lightness as well as hue. Each tile carries one figure at clamp(56px, 5.6vw, 96px) in its top-left corner, 28px in from the edges, with a two-line caption at 17px directly beneath it; the rest of the tile is empty colour, which is the point. Photograph and tiles touch, with no gaps and no rounding. The heading, two to four words at 32–40px, sits above the mosaic's left edge with 40px beneath, or is left out when the section follows a text page whose title already introduces it. Never add a third tile; with three figures choose another layout.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Quiet figure lines
entries.description: Numbers stated without raising the voice. In columns 2–7, a definition-list layout: three to five rows, each a two-track grid. The first track is 132px wide and holds the figure, right-aligned, at 28–32px in medium weight and full ink with tabular numerals. The second track, after a 24px gap, holds one sentence at 16–17px in the soft ink, at most 40ch, whose first baseline matches the figure's baseline. Sentences share one left edge and figures one right edge, so a clean channel of space runs down between them. 28px between rows. The heading, two to four words at 24–28px, sits 56px above on the sentences' left edge, not the figures'. Optionally, a single small square photograph occupies columns 9–11, its top 80px lower than the first row, with no caption. Leave at least 18vh of empty ground above and below the block.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Stepped figure tiles
entries.description: Three figures on three tiles that refuse to line up. A tall tile in the accent colour fills columns 1–6 and is 70vh high; it holds one figure at clamp(56px, 5.4vw, 92px) in its top-left corner, 28px in, and its caption at 17px in its bottom-left corner, with empty colour between. On the right, an ink-coloured tile in columns 7–9 starts 14vh lower and is 44vh high: a paper-coloured figure top-left, a caption along its bottom edge. A third tile in a mid tone takes columns 10–12, starts 26vh down and is 34vh high, with the same internal layout. Gaps are 8px. The unequal heights leave notches of bare ground above and below the right-hand tiles; the heading, two to four words at 28–36px, sits in the upper notch on column 7. If the page has a motif, cut one corner of each tile to its geometry with clip-path.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Total and its receipt
entries.description: A total at giant size, and beside it the slip that adds up to it. Left, columns 1–6: at the top the heading, two to five words at 40–44px, with a two-line note at 16px; at the bottom-left, anchored to the section's lower edge, the total at clamp(160px, 18vw, 300px) with leading 0.8, and one caption line at 17px under it. The space between heading and total is left empty. Right, columns 8–11: a paper-coloured slip 380–440px wide on the section's contrasting ground, top-aligned with the heading, its bottom edge a zigzag made with clip-path. The slip lists eight to fourteen rows in the text face at 15–16px with tabular numerals, grouped under bold group names; each row has a description on the left, a right-aligned value, and a leader of round 4px dots between. The last row is inverted on a solid ink bar and repeats the total. The slip's values must truly sum to the figure.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Quotes in the gutters
entries.description: A sticky stage (`position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh`) inside a wrapper three or four viewports tall. The section's title, two or three words at 10–12vw, stays pinned across the top of the stage. In the centre a portrait photograph, 4:5 and about 30vw wide, changes at each scroll step. Each step also brings one quotation, placed in an outer gutter in a column 280px wide and at a different height each time: right gutter in the upper third, then left gutter at mid-height, then right gutter in the lower third. Quotations are bold at 22px with tight leading; the speaker's name follows at 15px in the softer ink. Only one quotation shows at a time. Each step may switch the stage to its own flat ground colour. Drive the steps with an IntersectionObserver on spacer blocks; never hijack the scroll.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Lead quote, corner quotes
entries.description: A single field one viewport tall (min-height 100svh), usually the darkest tone of the palette. The lead quotation sits in the upper third: two lines at about 4vw in a light weight, centred, no wider than 60% of the viewport, with nothing near it. Two further short quotations are pushed into the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, each a block three columns wide set at 16px with leading 1.5, left-aligned, with the speaker's name and role on the two lines beneath in the softer ink. The bottom centre, about six columns wide, is deliberately empty. Use a three-row grid (auto 1fr auto) so the corner blocks hold a bottom margin of 32px while the lead quotation keeps its place at any height. There is no heading and there are no portraits; the contrast between one large voice and two small ones is the composition.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: One long letter
entries.description: A single testimonial given room to be read, set like a letter. One column 34–38ch wide begins at column 5 of 12, or shares the page's own reading column. The first sentence of the quotation is pulled up as the opening line at 28–32px in medium weight, two lines at most. The rest follows as two or three ordinary paragraphs at 18–19px with leading 1.55 and 20px between paragraphs, in the full ink, not grey. It closes the way a letter does: 40px of space, then the name on one line and the role on the next at 16px. In columns 1–3, top-aligned with the first line, sits either nothing or one small square photograph of the writer, 120px wide. There are no quotation marks at all; the letter form makes them unnecessary. Space above and below is 140px.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Name block, quote block
entries.description: Two flat blocks butt together across the full width with no gap, about 70svh tall, built as a two-column grid (5fr 7fr) whose cells stretch to equal height. The left block, columns 1–5, is in the page's ink colour and holds only the speaker: name at 20px medium and role at 16px in a softer tone, pinned to the bottom-left corner with 32px padding; the rest of the block is empty. The right block, columns 6–12, is in one palette colour and carries the quotation at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px), leading 1.15, top-left with 48px padding and a measure of about 24ch, so the lower third of the colour stays empty. Curly quotation marks are part of the text, with the opening mark hung outside the left edge by a negative `text-indent`. There is no heading; the quotation does that job.
entries.notes: Recipe metadata, not bundled font binaries or the referenced sites and photographs. Source-specific rights remain separate.

entries.title: Quotes on paper slips
entries.description: A heading of two to four words at about 3vw sits top-left in columns 1–6. Beneath it three paper slips fan across columns 2–11 on a contrasting flat ground: each is a filled paper-coloured panel about 300px wide, of three different lengths (440, 520 and 600px), rotated −4, 2 and 5 degrees and overlapping its neighbour by roughly 40px. The top and bottom edges of each slip are zigzag tears cut with `clip-path: polygon()`. On a slip, from the top: the speaker's name centred at 18px bold, the role on one line, a square greyscale photograph of the speaker 120px wide, then the quotation at 16px in the text face, left-aligned with 24px padding.
